description: This file defines the interface ProductRelationshipDao, which extends a generic DAO interface for managing ProductRelationship entities, providing methods to query product relationships based on various criteria within a specific merchant store environment.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipDao
classes.description: Interface for accessing product relationship data with methods for retrieving relationships by type, group, or products.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductRelationship objects filtered by store, type, product, and optionally language.

methods.name: listByProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductRelationship objects associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns product relationships categorized as groups within the specified store.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships that belong to a specific group within the store.
